name: repro
context_rationale: This skill asks clarifying questions interactively when the issue description is vague, relies on the user to confirm reproduction steps and environment, and its output (failing test path) feeds directly into the calling /slice session's BFRD-1 gate.
summary: Establishes a FAILING test that reproduces a bug before any fix code is written, codifying the tests-first-for-bug-fixes discipline. Parses the issue description (asking <=3 clarifying questions if vague), queries code-review-graph for context in the buggy code area, writes a runnable test under tests/bugs/, confirms it actually fails with the expected signature, then appends a shippability.json entry via scripts.lib.vault_edit append so the bug can never silently return. Hands off to /slice for the fix slice.

reads.purpose: Source graph for reachability/blast-radius/keyword queries on the buggy code area.

outputs.purpose: Append the new shippability catalog row so the reproduced bug is permanently tracked and caught by every future /validate-slice run.
The failing reproduction test that must be FAILING before /repro completes and PASSING after the fix slice ships.

tools.name: vault_edit
tools.purpose: SVW-1 safe-write: append the new shippability catalog row via the vault_edit append mechanism, never a raw Write/Edit.

tools.name: code-review-graph
tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — reachability / blast-radius / keyword+semantic search via CRG MCP tools. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read <vault>/shippability.json to determine the next entry number; read existing test files for framework conventions.

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Write the new failing test file under tests/bugs/ (or project's bug-test convention).

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Run code-review-graph queries and execute the test to confirm it fails with the expected signature (pytest / jest / go test etc.).

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: Ask up to 3 clarifying questions one at a time when the issue description is vague.

missing_references.reason: External pip package, intentionally not bundled in the plugin.
